title: Claim store
tests_run: python -m pytest tests/intelligence/test_claim_store.py tests/intelligence/test_storage.py tests/intelligence/test_provenance.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
tests_passed: 746 full CRIBA tests passed; 1 pre-existing dependency deprecation warning
decisions: Claim persistence uses an explicit whitelist of canonical intel_claims columns, so contract extensions cannot become SQL column names.
JSON reference fields are decoded on reads as Python lists; epistemic Enum inputs are stored as their string value.
The optional run_id storage field is supported without changing the public Claim contract.
risks: Claims do not have a created_at column, so list_claims orders by SQLite rowid rather than event time.
The existing IntelligenceStore schema remains version 1; no destructive migration was needed.
